stem.text: A ball is released from rest at position X at time zero. At $1.0\,\text{s}$, it bounces inelastically from a horizontal surface and rebounds, reaching the top of its first bounce at $1.5\,\text{s}$.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity in m s−1 against time/s. Velocity axis labels: 10, 5, 0, −5. Time axis labels: 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5.

stem.text: What is the total displacement of the ball from its original position X at $1.5\,\text{s}$?
